articles.summary: (All amounts in US$ unless otherwise indicated) Lithium Americas Corp. (TSX: LAC) (NYSE: LAC) (“ Lithium Americas ” or the “ Company ”) announced that it has filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, which includes the Company’s condensed consolidated interim financial statements (“ Financials ”) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 (“ Q3 2025 ”), and provided an update on its Thacker Pass lithium project in Humboldt County, Nevada (“ Thacker Pass ” or the “ Project ”). Jonathan
articles.title: Lithium Americas Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results
